caveats: No per-event odds timestamps: prices are batch-collected (Fri 17:00 UK for weekend fixtures, Tue 13:00 UK for midweek) - snapshots are window-close-inferred, never exact.

Residual legal risk: obtain explicit permission or a licensed alternative before scaling or any commercial use.
